title: Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee: Enrollment, Guaranteed Date and Payout Conditions
content:
**Terms of the Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee, a Larkspur Closing Cost Credit program**

1. **Enrollment.** The guarantee is enrolled on a purchase within the program's enrollment window of business days after the application date, and only when the contract closing date is at least the program's minimum number of calendar days after the application date.
2. **Guaranteed date.** The guaranteed closing date is the contract closing date at enrollment, and it does not move when the contract is amended.
3. **Late closing.** A guarantee payout is booked only when the loan was consummated after the guaranteed closing date. The consummation date recorded on the loan file is compared with the guaranteed closing date recorded on the credit, with no grace days (0): consummation on the guaranteed date itself is on time and owes nothing.
4. **Payout conditions.** The payout of the program's guarantee payout amount is owed only when the borrower delivered every requested document at least the program's document deadline in calendar days before the guaranteed closing date, as shown by the date document delivery was completed, and the delay was not caused by any of the program's excluded causes.
5. **Delivery.** A payout is delivered as a lender credit at closing and applied like any other credit.
6. **No closing.** A loan that never closes owes no payout.

The enrollment window, the minimum days, the document deadline, the excluded causes and the payout amount are program figures of the Closing Cost Credit.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, document deadline of 10 calendar days)

Guaranteed closing date: 15 July 2026.

| Fact | Date | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Consummation | 15 July 2026 | on time; nothing owed |
| Consummation | 16 July 2026 | after the guaranteed date; a payout may be owed |
| Documents complete | 5 July 2026 | 10 calendar days before; meets the deadline |
| Documents complete | 6 July 2026 | 9 calendar days before; misses the deadline |

### Conditions for a payout, together

| Consummated after the guaranteed date | Documents complete by the deadline | Delay from an excluded cause | Payout |
|---|---|---|---|
| no | any | any | none |
| yes | no | any | none |
| yes | any | yes | none |
| never closes | any | any | none |

A payout is owed only when the loan was consummated after the guaranteed date, the documents were complete by the deadline and the delay came from no excluded cause.

### Points of judgement

- An amendment that moves the contract closing date leaves the guaranteed closing date where it was at enrollment.
- The payout is not paid in cash: it is a lender credit at closing.
